Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer mistakenly identified the book "Dr. De Soto Goes to Africa" as the 1982 book by William Steig featuring a mouse dentist. In reality, the correct book is "Doctor De Soto," published in 1982, while "Dr. De Soto Goes to Africa" was published later in 1994. This error occurred because the WebSurfer failed to cross-verify the publication year of "Dr. De Soto Goes to Africa" and relied on incorrect search results without proper validation, leading to the wrong solution.
